_comment: The engine-gap ledger: plugin state shapes the generic grammar could not represent, typed so demand is COUNTABLE. tools/engine-gap-doc.php projects docs/guides/adapter-authoring-limitations.md from this file and `make release-gate` byte-compares the result, so the prose and the data cannot disagree. `primitives` is a CLOSED vocabulary -- the projector refuses a coordinate naming a primitive that is not declared here, and refuses a declared primitive nothing demands. That closure is the whole point: two candidates blocked on the same missing thing must name the SAME primitive id, so the open-demand ranking counts one primitive with two candidates rather than two lookalike wishlist lines. Adding a row is a review act, not a note-to-self: every `closed_by`/`evidence` path is checked to exist on disk, so a closed gap whose implementation moved fails the gate instead of quietly becoming a claim about nothing. CLOSURE IS PER COORDINATE (WP-6.1): `closed_by` sits on the coordinate whose primitive shipped, and a candidate's `disposition` is derived from its coordinates and merely checked -- `closed` exactly when every one of them carries `closed_by`. WP-6.1 forced that split by shipping a primitive that unblocked part of a row and none of the rest, which row-level closure could only state as one of two false sentences.

closed_block_value_shapes.title: strict scalar and disjoint literal/object block values
closed_block_value_shapes.definition: Negotiated block-value-shapes/v1 refines authored plain-data scalar types and composes exactly one literal enum with one closed object rule. Both alternatives reuse recursive grammar, identity codecs, immutable post/widget validation, publication clearance and actual transactional materialization. Original comment framing and parser-free Lint share the pure contract; no runtime schema lookup, plugin executable or trial fallback is introduced.

structured_post_body_reference_paths.title: structured post-body reference paths
structured_post_body_reference_paths.definition: Addressing a reference inside a post BODY by a declared path, so a source-local id embedded in structured post_content is rebound rather than carried over verbatim. Shipped as the `json` post-type body mode plus the top-level `body_refs` section, both gated on the engine feature `structured-body-refs/v1` (spec/repo-format.md § v3.20). The path dialect is the shipped `json_refs` one, unchanged; what the primitive adds beside it is the identity round-trip precondition over the whole document, the per-path declared JSON type, and the declared `sentinels` literal set that keeps a non-reference value at a reference path a refusal rather than a guess.

type_preserving_string_id_attr_codec.title: a type-preserving string-id attribute codec
type_preserving_string_id_attr_codec.definition: A block/shortcode attribute codec that resolves an entity id and writes it back in the JSON type it was stored as, instead of normalising every id to an integer.

taxonomy_delete_scope_exercise.title: a complete taxonomy/delete-scope exercise
taxonomy_delete_scope_exercise.definition: The adversarial matrix that must run before a post-type adapter carrying an authored taxonomy may claim a deletion selector: term-attached state, cascade scope, and residue on a dirty target. Shipped as the matrix itself, run offline through the shipped decision path against a committed adapter's own declaration -- the guard read (DeleteGuardReferenceScanner), the plan annotation (DeleteGuardEvaluator::annotate_plan_guard_findings), the authorization gate (ApplyPreparationCoordinator::prepare) and the cascade (DeleteExecutor::delete_entity), with a before/after census over the eight tables a term deletion could reach. Each of the three named cases, plus the negative that an unadvertised selector refuses, carries a mutation proof that removes its outcome: what is measured is the declaration, not the fixture. It does NOT claim the InnoDB locking half -- FOR UPDATE is parsed and not modelled offline -- which stays with sandbox/tests/certify/certify_deletion_matrix.sh.

column_field_templates.title: opaque field references and authored literals inside typed columns
column_field_templates.definition: Negotiated brace and brace-enabled expression maps preserve header identities while transporting literal text through existing tokens. Canonical fragments prove unambiguous native syntax, share root bounds and retain complete metadata byte checks plus joined literal destination roles. This does not bind CSV inputs or qualify import jobs.

column_field_template_requirements.title: required functional members inside typed-column field-template maps
column_field_template_requirements.definition: A feature-gated field-template declaration can require named brace expressions to be nonempty, or named brace-enabled definitions to be both nonempty and enabled. The shared value contract enforces the same bounded sorted declaration during Capture, immutable compilation, lint and Apply; it adds no defaults and interprets no plugin expressions.

column_field_labels.title: explicit field-definition maps inside typed columns
column_field_labels.definition: Negotiated label and label-enabled maps validate metadata shape before projecting immediate field-code PII roles. Every key and value remains scanned for private bytes, enclosing roles remain intact, and secret clearance retains the original decoded value. The shared text codec preserves native labels and flags; this grants no adapter qualification.

typed_column_value_contracts.title: shared authored value contracts inside strict stored column containers
typed_column_value_contracts.definition: Explicit semantic column values compose faithful JSON/PHP framing with the shared bounded object, literal, reference and text codecs. Strict user bindings retain native scalar types at divergent local IDs; canonical compilation, scoped materialization and decoded clearance use the same contracts. This grants no local-file binding or adapter qualification.

serialized_column_codec.title: structured typed-table column codecs that decode, tokenize string leaves, and re-encode canonical PHP serialization
serialized_column_codec.definition: A typed-table column codec that round-trips a PHP-serialized container: decode, tokenize the string leaves, re-encode with correct length prefixes. Distinct from structured_leaf_text_codec because the re-encode half is the hazard -- a tokenized string of a different byte length invalidates the serialization.

verified_provider_postcondition.title: a provider whose success is a bounded, verified postcondition rather than an exit-code-only callback
verified_provider_postcondition.definition: The engine negotiates a digest-bound capability before mutation, supplies only its declared bounded batch/context, and accepts success only after the provider returns a value-level verified receipt whose declared readable surfaces agree with engine readback. A plugin still needs its own native implementation and adversarial evidence; availability of this facility is not evidence for that plugin.

host_checkpointed_schema_settlement.title: host-checkpointed schema settlement before strict target observation
host_checkpointed_schema_settlement.definition: A host-only provider phase that establishes a manifest-declared table set after an authenticated database checkpoint and before strict target observation, with create-only row/schema receipts, continuously fenced lifecycle/provider ordering, durable external debt, and exact-checkpoint recovery. The plugin provider retains installer semantics; the engine owns authority, sequencing, and recovery.

plugin_incompatibility_contract.title: a deterministic exact-plugin incompatibility contract
plugin_incompatibility_contract.definition: A plugin-owning manifest can name a sorted set of exact competing plugin basenames that cannot share its aggregate policy. The shared finalizer chooses no winner: one declaration refuses both pin orders before compilation, capture publication, promotion, lifecycle, or provider mutation, and the boundary is not operator-overridable composition.

verified_module_flush_provider.title: a verified plugin-module flush and native readback provider
verified_module_flush_provider.definition: A plugin-owned provider that restricts raw table materialization to the reviewed module, invokes the plugin's public module/cache boundary, and returns success only after bounded database, native API and lookup-cache readback agrees. The provider receipt contains counts and hashes rather than authored values.

structured_leaf_text_codec.title: an explicit structured-leaf text codec independent of fake reference paths
structured_leaf_text_codec.definition: Explicit URL/query-reference text rewriting in decoded plain-data string leaves without inventing entity-reference paths. Existing plain_data rules dispatch through Tokens for nested option/meta values; body-url-rebinding/v1 adds an explicit JSON-body opt-in. Declared JSON reference positions and literal sentinels remain owned by their reference grammar.

reviewed_structured_scalar_pii_paths.title: reviewed scalar-field privacy authority inside structured bodies
reviewed_structured_scalar_pii_paths.definition: The separately negotiated body-pii-paths/v1 feature admits exact scalar-field pii_paths in a JSON body record. The existing JSONPath matcher selects native coordinates for PersonalData; Capture and immutable compilation share that authority without rewriting values or exempting key bytes, containers, siblings or secrets. This is authored-field review, not environment substitution or response-data capture.

post_apply_registration_boundary.title: a verified post-apply type-registration/process boundary
post_apply_registration_boundary.definition: A stated, verified boundary for state that a plugin consumes during `init`: applied definitions do not exist in the process that wrote them, so entity materialization depending on them must be sequenced across processes rather than assumed.

dynamic_option_name_reference_rule.title: a generic dynamic derived option-name reference rule
dynamic_option_name_reference_rule.definition: Widens the shipped `option_name_refs` rule, which captures a numeric ROW id out of the option name, to a name whose dynamic segment is a slug and whose VALUE is the local reference.

composite_ref_identity.title: join-table identity with no scalar primary key (`identity.mode: composite_ref`)
composite_ref_identity.definition: A pure join table's identity is its two reference columns, not a row id: every identity column is a ref and every ref is an identity column.

option_name_refs.title: an option-name reference rule binding a numeric row id captured from the option NAME
option_name_refs.definition: A top-level `option_name_refs` list whose anchored `match` regex carries exactly one named `(?<id>...)` capture bound to a table id_kind, driving its own name-scan discovery pass.

row_cache_invalidation.title: a per-row `invalidate` declaration that drops a plugin's own derived cache after every apply-time write
row_cache_invalidation.definition: Invalidate rather than rebuild: a plugin whose read site falls through to a fresh read when its cache row is ABSENT needs the row deleted, not reconstructed, and needs no rebuild command to exist.

manifest_regenerator.title: a declared regenerator that rebuilds derived tables from applied authored state and fails loudly on a stale row
manifest_regenerator.definition: An always-on-write `regen_dependency` naming a regenerator file, for derived state where row EXISTENCE is not a sufficient postcondition because a present row can disagree with the authored state that was just applied.

row_cache_entry_invalidation.title: a per-row object-cache ENTRY invalidation, whose key or group carries the row id
row_cache_entry_invalidation.definition: A `tables.<t>.invalidate[]` verb naming one WordPress object-cache entry -- `{cache_group, cache_key}`, with `{id}` substituting the row's resolved local id into either member -- dropped and PROVEN gone after every apply-time write to that row. Distinct from `row_cache_invalidation`, which reaches a cache stored AS a database row (a table row or an option); no DELETE reaches the object cache. Admitted on TWO independent demands and not before: Paid Memberships Pro's retired provider put the id on the key side, `adapter-packages/woocommerce/package/runtime/providers/woocommerce-product-lookups.php:1301` puts it on the group side, and it is the second that made the rule '{id} in EITHER member' rather than a transcription of one plugin's spelling. `adapter-packages/paid-memberships-pro/package/manifest.json` is the first shipped declarative consumer.

conditional_structured_references.title: closed sibling-discriminated structural references
conditional_structured_references.definition: Feature-negotiated json_refs conditions select an ordinary typed reference only for an exact sibling discriminator, preserve listed non-reference variants through the text codec, and refuse unknown variants before publication or SQL mutation. Body and taxonomy-description reference declarations remain outside this feature.

ordered_php_option_containers.title: a closed ordered PHP array/stdClass option codec
ordered_php_option_containers.definition: The negotiated php-container-values/v1 whole-option codec preserves native array/object types, insertion order and finite float types in plain canonical data. Typed key_refs reuse the existing path walker and identity ledger while changing items and ordering records atomically. Native decoding forbids executable classes and enums; immutable validation and checked SQL apply share the same representation.

closed_block_attribute_rosters.title: closed exact native block attribute inventories
closed_block_attribute_rosters.definition: Negotiated block-attribute-closure/v1 closes selected owned blocks over their normalized block_values names and disjoint legacy paths. Capture, immutable post/widget compilation, lint and Apply reject unknown attribute presence without displaying unreviewed field names or values. The existing declaration projection supplies internal roster metadata; no runtime schema lookup, plugin executable, site override or default codec is added.

structured_block_attribute_values.title: declarative structured block values and derived cache exclusion
structured_block_attribute_values.definition: Exact Gutenberg attributes reuse scalar/list/CSV, JSON-path/key-map and text codecs; derived editor caches are excluded explicitly, with matching immutable validation and checked native post transport.

saved_html_media_references.title: a shared structural HTML media-class reference codec
saved_html_media_references.definition: Recognize reserved WordPress media class tokens in actual HTML class attributes across plugin, core, classic and widget content. Reuse identity/scope handling and require literal canonical tokens visible to the repository graph.

declared_media_derivative_recipes.title: declared custom media derivative recipes with durable file ownership
declared_media_derivative_recipes.definition: Rebuild custom image sizes selected by authored content when the native plugin writes those files outside attachment metadata. Derive bounded recipes from declared content references and dimensions, then publish and recover generated files through shared media authority rather than promoting a derived plugin cache as authored state.

exact_post_meta_invalidation.title: exact derived post-cache invalidation on authored writes
exact_post_meta_invalidation.definition: The negotiated post-meta-invalidation/v1 rule deletes an exact derived metadata key only on a post or menu item already being materialized. The shared bounded owner lock, checked SQL, absence readback, cache invalidation queue and authored transaction own the effect; no native hook, wildcard sweep or plugin executable is added.

native_encoded_text_values.title: explicit native scalar text framing
native_encoded_text_values.definition: The negotiated encoded-text-values/v1 constraint decodes URI-component persistence, with an optional reversible literal escape, before existing URL, reference and privacy handling. Canonical state contains decoded UTF-8 text; Apply re-encodes after target rebinding. Exact spelling, scalar shape, collisions and expansion bounds are shared across capture, pure compilation and materialization.

decoded_block_attribute_clearance.title: decoded block attributes at publication clearance
decoded_block_attribute_clearance.definition: The pure block-comment reader exposes decoded attribute values alongside original body text for existing secret and personal-data checks. Native JSON quote escaping cannot conceal scalar signatures in ordinary or unknown blocks. Capture and immutable post/widget compilation share this framing without rewriting canonical bytes or widening privacy exceptions.

block_record_field_projection.title: authored fields within native structured block records
block_record_field_projection.definition: Declare one record or a list of records and retain exact authored fields before existing reference, URL and privacy transport. Reject excluded canonical fields and any declaration that could discard a reference.

any_block_structured_attribute_reference.title: reference paths inside a block attribute the plugin injects into every block
any_block_structured_attribute_reference.definition: Addressing entity references that live INSIDE one block attribute's nested value, on blocks the declaring plugin does not enumerate because it injects the attribute into every registered block. `block_attrs` binds one TOP-LEVEL attribute key per EXACT block name, over a value vocabulary closed at {int,int[]} (`AttributeGrammar::ATTR_VALUE_TYPES`, whose own refusal says 'any other shape needs engine support before it can be declared'). Two independent things are missing: a rule that reaches any block rather than a named one, and a reference path INTO an attribute value whose kind depends on a sibling key — the `json_refs` dialect already shipped for options and meta, plus `kind_from`-style dispatch already shipped for whole attributes, but neither is available beneath a block attribute. Without both, such an id is carried into canonical state verbatim and lands on a target pointing at an unrelated entity, and lint does not catch it: `unregistered_block_attr` fires on attributes named id/ids/ref or ending in Id/Ids holding a NUMERIC value, and the carrier here is an object.

composed_block_value_contracts.title: exact composed block objects with literal and reference-integrity constraints
composed_block_value_contracts.definition: Negotiated block-value-contracts/v1 composes existing authored codecs under exact object_fields, admits bounded site-independent enum literals and refuses unresolved reference leaves when dropping an identity would change query meaning. This is an extension of block_values, with no new plugin executable or option/metadata authority.

column_record_projection.title: shared immediate record projection inside typed columns
column_record_projection.definition: Explicit column-record-fields/v1 enables existing RecordFields for strict typed columns. Immediate authored fields survive; canonical excluded fields refuse and original decoded clearance remains. Native consumers must prove excluded context is regenerable; this grants no target-local merge or template qualification.

table_row_scope_sets.title: bounded alternative values for typed-table row ownership
table_row_scope_sets.definition: Negotiated sorted finite discriminator sets reuse the shared byte-exact PHP and prepared SQL ownership predicate. Every discriminator remains conjunctive; complete natural keys, locking, liveness, recovery and cross-owner exclusions are preserved. This grants no import payload or file binding authority.

column_value_cases.title: row-selected semantic contracts inside one typed column
column_value_cases.definition: A negotiated exact case list selects an existing authored value contract using one declared row_scope set. Every case shares framing, feature negotiation, keyspace checks and the manifest rule budget. Capture, compilation, privacy, lint and checked writes use the selected contract; no implicit default or local-file authority.

column_input_files.title: target-local file dependencies inside typed columns
column_input_files.definition: A negotiated nested input-file leaf carries only canonical dependency presence. Compiled ownership derives the operator coordinate; the existing private environment store owns a filename in the declared content directory. Plan selects pointer rebinding without widening drift or conflict, and selected Apply locks intent, validates availability before effects and commit, and uses the ordinary typed writer. No input contents are transported and later plugin jobs remain separate.

typed_object_record_projection.title: record projection composed with exact typed object fields
typed_object_record_projection.definition: Negotiated object-record-fields/v1 composes existing record_fields with object_fields on both block and strict column value contracts. Both declarations own the same retained field set; child codecs remain explicit, complete native data stays subject to bounds and privacy checks, and excluded canonical fields refuse before target resolution.

coordinates.cannot_represent: `wpforms` post content is a JSON document carrying declared page and optional self references. The original structured-body feature closes fixed-type confirmation paths, including the string sentinel `previous_page`. Native create/template content may omit the top-level `id`; the builder=false path writes an integer and the real builder writes a string. A present id is authoritative form identity, not form-local data: leaving it undeclared can bind a submitted form to an unrelated target form. The additional `body-ref-preserve-type/v1` feature declares that path with `cast: preserve` and retains int/string type beside an ordinary identity token. The shared codec, real compiler portability pass, lint and PostCapture are exercised with exact native fixture bytes, divergent target IDs, old-ID collisions and malformed canonical records. Missing paths remain missing. This closes the reference representation gap, not native WPForms support or same-site URL rebinding.

Native WPForms confirmation redirects and message content contain same-site absolute URLs inside JSON string leaves. Reference-only body=json preserved those URLs and warned; the retained form-b body exhibits the escaped source-home redirect. The separately negotiated body-url-rebinding/v1 feature now admits url_rebinding: true and reuses the existing home/uploads/query-reference text codec. JsonRefs protects exact native reference coordinates and sentinels, including dotted-key ambiguity, without a second path dialect or plugin-owned walker. Real compiler, PostCapture and checked-SQL PostMaterializer regressions prove the combined typed-reference/URL fixed point, native fixture framing, hostile source-ID collision isolation and mutation-free malformed-reference refusal. This closes representation and dispatch, not native WPForms product support.
coordinates.remedy_phrase: explicit URL rebinding for structured JSON body string leaves

coordinates.cannot_represent: Replacing the retained native fixture's notification smart tags with synthetic literal recipient/sender/reply-to settings reproduces refusal in both real PostCapture and immutable-repository authorization. JSON bodies previously had no exact reviewed PII exception. body-pii-paths/v1 now admits pii_paths through the existing path dialect, restricted to named first/terminal segments and no recursive descent. The generic detector selects only native scalar coordinates and keeps key bytes, containers, unreviewed siblings and all secrets protected. Complete compiler, checked-SQL materializer and PostCapture tests prove exact typed-reference/URL/notification composition, hostile-input refusals and source/native preservation. Native writer persistence and notification delivery remain adapter evidence, not implied by these synthetic literal mutations.
coordinates.remedy_phrase: reviewed scalar privacy paths without whole-body or secret clearance

coordinates.cannot_represent: Every `wpforms` post carries a `wpforms_form_locations` postmeta row: a PHP-serialized list of the posts that EMBED the form, each entry holding the embedding post's id, permalink path, and denormalized copies of its title and status. Read at the source it is unambiguously DERIVED rather than authored — `WPForms\Forms\Locator::hooks()` maintains it on `save_post`, `post_updated`, `wp_trash_post`, `untrash_post`, `delete_post`, `permalink_structure_changed` and three widget-option writes (src/Forms/Locator.php:203-216), and `FormsLocatorScanTask` rebuilds it in FULL from a REGEXP over `post_content` on a recurring `DAY_IN_SECONDS` schedule (src/Tasks/Actions/FormsLocatorScanTask.php:153, :184-186, :387). So `class: "derived"` represents it and it needs no new declarative primitive to capture. What is not representable is the apply-side postcondition: WPrism writes `wp_posts` with a direct `Db::update()` (agent/src/Apply/PostMaterializer.php:229), so none of those eight hooks fires and a target's locations meta stays stale until the plugin's own scheduled scan next runs. A derivation that is scheduled rather than synchronous is exactly the bounded postcondition this primitive is about, and an exit code from a rebuild command would not prove it either. The 2026-08-22 pass could not have seen this coordinate: the row only exists once a form is actually embedded in a page and the locator scan has run, which a hand-written fixture never triggers.
coordinates.remedy_phrase: a bounded postcondition over the plugin's scheduled form-locations derivation

coordinates.cannot_represent: The `wpforms/form-selector` Gutenberg block persists `formId` as a JSON string. The current block-reference codec accepts `int|int[]` and writes an integer back, changing the stored type even if the identity resolves.
Forms also use the `wpforms_form_tag` taxonomy. A forms-only post-type draft omits authored plugin state.

candidates.closing: Fixed-type JSON reference paths, block selector codecs and the fixture taxonomy decision matrix have offline evidence at their cited owners. The optional integer/string self-reference is represented by body-ref-preserve-type/v1, not preserved as an undeclared source-local id. The body-url-rebinding/v1 feature separately composes the existing URL/query text codec with exact reference/sentinel protection; real compiler, checked-SQL post materialization and PostCapture prove an exact body fixed point and mutation-free hostile input refusal. These close the measured representation/dispatch gaps, not the native product evidence. The bounded native form-locations postcondition remains adapter-owned. The historical taxonomy matrix proves offline declaration/decision behavior only, not concurrent InnoDB locking or a production deletion claim. The WPForms site adapter and captured 2.0.0.5 bodies are authoring/trust-flow fixtures, not platform support. Complete native create/update/builder/duplicate, divergent-ID materialization, submission, URL, location, lifecycle and composition evidence is still required before any product disposition.

coordinates.cannot_represent: `redirection_items.action_data` is a native storage union: plain target URL text, a PHP-serialized conditional map containing target URLs, or SQL NULL. Treating every value as opaque text corrupts PHP serialization length prefixes after tokenization; treating every value as serialized refuses valid plain and NULL actions.
coordinates.remedy_phrase: structured typed-table column codecs that decode, tokenize string leaves, and re-encode canonical PHP serialization

coordinates.cannot_represent: Group/item raw writes also bypass `Red_Module::flush()`, so generated module state needs a bounded postcondition rather than an exit-code-only callback.

candidates.closing: Closed by the 2026-08-27 one-prompt authoring exercise. `mixed-column-codecs/v1` represents the measured plain/serialized/NULL action_data union without changing strict `php_serialized` semantics. The exact 5.9.0 provider restricts state to the WordPress module, advances the native cache generation when enabled, and proves database/API/lookup convergence with value-free receipts. Offline mutation tests and the hostile-target live conformance exercise cover malformed framing, stale APIs, unsupported modules, cache repair, divergent identities, real HTTP behavior, conflicts, retry and recapture.

coordinates.cannot_represent: `cptui_post_types` and `cptui_taxonomies` are nested authored arrays whose menu_icon may be a site URL. The shared plain_data rule now supplies explicit string-leaf URL rebinding through OptionsCapture, Tokens and OptionsMaterializer, without a fake reference declaration. CPT UI still needs its own reviewed declaration and native round-trip/registration evidence; this coordinate is adapter work, not a missing text primitive.
coordinates.remedy_phrase: an explicit structured-leaf text codec independent of fake reference paths

coordinates.cannot_represent: WPrism writes options after WordPress `init`; CPT UI registers its dynamic post types and taxonomies during `init`. Newly applied definitions therefore do not exist in the same process that would need them for entity materialization.

A taxonomy `default_term` produces `default_term_<taxonomy>` with a local term id. The option name is dynamic and the value is derived/reference-shaped; treating it as ordinary authored data would leak a local id.
coordinates.remedy_phrase: a generic dynamic derived option-name reference rule

candidates.closing: Until those exist, no CPT UI manifest is shipped.

coordinates.cannot_represent: Typed rows and shortcode refs were representable, but direct table writes bypassed the plugin's object-cache cleanup and optional flat-file execution rebuild, so the adapter could not claim apply without a bounded native postcondition.

Code Snippets' own cleanup drops `wp_cache_delete(Settings\CACHE_KEY, CACHE_GROUP)` (adapter-packages/code-snippets/package/runtime/providers/code-snippets-state.php:94) -- one settings entry the whole `snippets` table shares, keyed by neither the row nor anything derived from it. WP-6.2's `{cache_group, cache_key}` verb requires `{id}` in one member, so a table-scoped entry still has no declarative spelling and this plugin's object cache stays reachable only through a provider.

candidates.closing: Closed by the certified Code Snippets 3.9.5/3.9.6 provider path. It invokes the plugin's native cache and flat-file boundaries, verifies native readback plus hash-only receipts, and is exercised under enabled/disabled flat-file modes, injected faults, retry and recapture. The literal table-wide cache entry remains provider-owned because one plugin demand is not enough reason to widen the engine-native invalidation grammar.

coordinates.cannot_represent: `pmpro_memberships_pages` and `pmpro_memberships_categories` are pure join tables: a two-column composite primary key, every identity column a reference, and no scalar row id at all. `identity.mode` admitted only `mapped` and `natural_key`, both of which require a scalar `pk`, so the membership-to-page and membership-to-category relationships stayed honest-intent markers in the manifest rather than declarations.

candidates.closing: Closed in issue #3235 together with the `id_column` meta-table gap from the same round.

coordinates.cannot_represent: A shipping zone method stores its settings in an option whose NAME embeds the local zone-method row id (`woocommerce_<method>_<id>_settings`). Options were addressable only by literal name -- the `options` section is an exact whitelist and `option_patterns` drove no discovery scan -- so an option whose name carries a local reference could be neither discovered nor rebound, and shipping zones had no engine path at all.

candidates.closing: Closed in task #93, which graduated shipping zones and tax rates from an intent marker to a declared surface.

coordinates.cannot_represent: Ninja Forms caches a form's settings and fields in `nf3_upgrades` plus a legacy `nf_form_<id>` option. An apply-time write to a form's own row left that cache stale, so an id-reused form silently served the PREVIOUS form's settings. The grammar could express the row write but not the derived state the plugin's own save path drops, and Ninja Forms ships no rebuild command (`wp help nf` fails) for an exit-code callback to shell out to.

candidates.closing: Closed by reading Ninja Forms' own read site rather than by trial: `ModelFactory` falls through to a fresh `nf3_forms`/`nf3_fields` read the moment the cache row is ABSENT, which is why invalidation is sufficient and a rebuilder was not required to close the gap.

coordinates.cannot_represent: The Events Calendar keeps every event's dates in the derived custom tables `tec_events`/`tec_occurrences`, which capture excludes. Row EXISTENCE was the only postcondition the grammar could state, and an adopted target event can already hold a `tec_occurrences` row whose dates disagree with the applied post meta -- a present-but-stale row that an existence check passes.

candidates.closing: Closed in issue #3234 plus the 2026-08-22 production-readiness stale-row regression; the existence check remains as the generic backstop underneath the regenerator.

coordinates.cannot_represent: PMPro reads membership-level metadata through get_metadata(), which caches per level id in the `pmpro_membership_level_meta` object-cache group. WPrism writes `pmpro_membership_levelmeta` by SQL and fires none of the metadata API's invalidation, so an applied level served its PRE-APPLY meta for as long as that entry lived. `invalidate[]` could delete a table row or an option row but had no verb for an object-cache ENTRY, so the whole repair had to be hook code: one action, one `providers[].source: "manifest"` row, and a provider whose entire product act is wp_cache_delete() in a loop -- which alone held the adapter at `compatibility_shim`.

candidates.closing: Closed in WP-6.2 by generalising the verb rather than by adopting only PMPro's spelling: WooCommerce's `object_<id>`/`lookup_table` drop (adapter-packages/woocommerce/package/runtime/providers/woocommerce-product-lookups.php:1301) is the second independent demand and puts the id on the GROUP side, so the admitted rule is `{id}` in EITHER member. The engine proves the drop with a wp_cache_get() readback; an unverified delete would ship the stale read in a shorter spelling. The shipped PMPro manifest now consumes that primitive, its 233-line provider and both executable declarations are retired, and the product regression observes the committed value through PMPro's native cache semantics. This intentional manifest-identity change requires ordinary recompilation and re-pinning.

coordinates.cannot_represent: Rank Math activation does not create the authored redirection tables while its redirections module is disabled, but strict plan observation correctly refuses to invent absent declared schema. Existing lifecycle and apply actions therefore had no safe point at which to run the plugin installer: before a checkpoint it was unrecoverable DDL, while after observation it was already too late.

Rank Math and Yoast each have an independently valid adapter contract but compete for the same conceptual SEO authority.
